name: sol8-viewer-and-state-review
goal: Viewer controls and provenance match displayed evidence; state words remain whole; catalog captures are distinct and consistently framed.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Inspected all 18 original f646 catalog images in record f1cd47a4: enabled empty navigation, wrong After provenance, split Required word, duplicate catalog states and narrow config framing. See loop README.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing catalog checked presence and counts but omitted disabled navigation, displayed-side provenance, caption spacing, whole-word geometry and distinct fixtures. Reusable assertions now run directly in the named standard catalog test; fixture corrections precede the frozen pair.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record a2d0368f at d31c7d3407: 8 assertion failures and 4 passes; 12 original desktop/tablet/mobile images retained. No fixture/setup errors. Navigation, After provenance and mobile whole-word guards fail.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 56d5c11d97 and ae2393abc6 disable unavailable navigation, bind metadata/title to displayed evidence, space caption separators and preserve Required words. The complete test corpus remains unchanged from d31c7d3407.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 2f4cd5d6 at dd3bd67e8f passes all 12 cases, paired with a2d0368f at d31c7d3407. Tests, fixtures, command, inputs and environment match. Original pixels inspected; final capture readiness and broader verification remain pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
